items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Okay. I remember going to the house of your colleague Dave Rivello...

ctx.x: Okay. I remember going to the house of your colleague Dave Rivello and I was pleased to see this big — it was almost like an architectural type table and he had his King manuscript paper.

He’s very good at outlining with all that. I wish I was as organized. Although I mean every artist has their space, I think there’s been lots of documentaries on that. But your living/sort of working space and it’s certainly — I actually thought oh I’m finally going to be a real professor with my own office at a school and I’m going to work there. And I can barely work there because there’s too much work there. I still need my own space to work in. So your home space becomes really important I think once you…

And Dave’s done a great job of that with having lots of space to freely write. And that’s kind of what I have with my studio in Montreal that I’m still spending a lot of time at, and hopefully I’ll develop one here more but I haven’t yet because I’m still trying to figure out Rochester.
